1.web: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding:
1.asv: My son, attend unto my wisdom; Incline thine ear to my understanding:

2.web: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
2.asv: That thou mayest preserve discretion, And that thy lips may keep knowledge.

3.web: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
3.asv: For the lips of a strange woman drop honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil:

4.web: But in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
4.asv: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.

5.web: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
5.asv: Her feet go down to death; Her steps take hold on Sheol;

6.web: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
6.asv: So that she findeth not the level path of life: Her ways are unstable, andshe knoweth it not.

7.web: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
7.asv: Now therefore, mysons, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.

8.web: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
8.asv: Remove thy way far from her, And come not nigh the door of her house;

9.web: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
9.asv: Lest thou give thine honor unto others, And thy years unto the cruel;

10.web: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
10.asv: Lest strangers be filled with thy strength, And thy labors be in the house of an alien,

11.web: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
11.asv: And thou mourn at thy latter end, When thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

12.web: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
12.asv: And say, How have I hated instruction, And my heart despised reproof;

13.web: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
13.asv: Neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

14.web: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, in the midst of the gathered assembly.”
14.asv: I was well-nigh in all evil In the midst of the assembly and congregation.

15.web: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
15.asv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, And running waters out of thine own well.

16.web: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
16.asv: Should thy springs be dispersed abroad, And streams of water in the streets?

17.web: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
17.asv: Let them be for thyself alone, And not for strangers with thee.

18.web: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
18.asv: Let thy fountain be blessed; And rejoice in the wife of thy youth.

19.web: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
19.asv: Asa loving hind and a pleasant doe, Let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; And be thou ravished always with her love.

20.web: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
20.asv: For why shouldest thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, And embrace the bosom of a foreigner?

21.web: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Yahweh. He examines all his paths.
21.asv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Jehovah; And he maketh level all his paths.

22.web: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
22.asv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked, And he shall be holden with the cords of his sin.

23.web: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
23.asv: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
